detail.longDescription: I am using the `googletrans` library for the first time to run some tests. Even if I change the source language, it still fails to provide any translation. For this unsuccessful translation attempt, I only get the following output: 2 Tutorial googletrans: async def 2 Tutorial googletrans: 2 Tutorial googletrans result2: Translated(src=en, dest=en, text=Hola mundo., pronunciation=Hola mundo., extra_data="{'translat...") Hola mundo. {'translation': [['Hola mundo.', None, None, 0]], 'all-translations': None, 'original-language': 'en', 'possible-translations': None, 'confidence': 1, 'possible-mistakes': None, 'language': [['en'], None, [1], ['en']], 'synonyms': None, 'definitions': None, 'examples': None, 'see-also': None} Fin 2 Tutorial googletrans: I hope you can help me.
